companions.title: Pokémon FireRed Companion
companions.description: FireRed companion in the console layout of the Emerald pack, in a soft red pastel palette: a Map page with a TOWN / WORLD switch (the live map of your area, or the Town Map with your spot) and the wild Pokémon around you, party (tap a Pokémon for its stats and moves), bag by pocket, a Pokédex list with entries, trainer card, and a battle page with FIGHT, BAG, POKéMON and RUN buttons plus a move list with type effectiveness (the buttons need Packs can change games). Has a WIDE button that paints the game's world beside the picture, and a COLOR button for a fuller look (GBADuo 0.1.12 or newer).
companions.author: khumam

screenshots.alt: Map page: the Town Map with your spot and the wild Pokémon here
Party page: tap a card for that Pokémon's details
Pokédex list with the selected entry
Battle page with FIGHT, BAG, POKéMON and RUN buttons

companions.title: Golden Sun Companion (Early Preview)
companions.description: Early preview for Golden Sun, dressed in the game's own blue windows: a party roster with each member's HP, stats, items and the Djinn they hold, Psynergy with its icons, and an area Maps page that follows your character. The WIDE button paints the world beside the picture and shows nearby people in the margins; a COLOR button gives the picture a fuller look with soft shadows (GBADuo 0.1.13 or newer). Wide view and Maps are tested on the US ROM only.
companions.author: khumam

screenshots.alt: Golden Sun party page with the roster, stats and items
Golden Sun Djinn page listing all four elements and who holds each
Golden Sun Psynergy page with each spell's icon and PP
Golden Sun Options page with Wide view and Color ambient

companions.title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap Companion
companions.description: World and dungeon maps with Link's spot, his hearts, items, kinstone fusions, and quest progress, drawn from your own ROM. Tap Ezlo for a hint. Has a WIDE button that paints the world beside the picture, with nearby enemies and NPCs drawn in the margins and the HUD tucked away (the pack asks before changing the game). A COLOR button gives the picture a fuller look with soft shadows and drifting clouds (GBADuo 0.1.13 or newer).
companions.author: khumam
